query_ground_truth.workflow_task: Reconcile an organization's QuickBooks bank-account ledger by querying existing transactions, removing or undoing incorrect entries, posting corrected ledger activity, creating adjustment entries, recording a customer payment, and verifying financial reports.
query_ground_truth.query: fetch financial reports to verify reconciliation
query_ground_truth.rationale: Verifying financial reports requires retrieving generated account reports to ensure the ledger matches up correctly.

QUICKBOOKS_GET_REPORT_TRIAL_BALANCE.description: Generate a Trial Balance report showing account debits, credits, and balances for a specified period. Use when you need to verify that total debits equal total credits across all accounts for accounting reconciliation.

end_date.description: Report end date in YYYY-MM-DD format. If not provided, defaults to today's date.

date_macro.description: Predefined date range. Use if you want the report to cover a standard report date range; otherwise, use the start_date and end_date to cover an explicit report date range.

start_date.description: Report start date in YYYY-MM-DD format. If not provided, defaults to the start of the current fiscal year.

report_date.description: Start date to use for the report, in the format YYYY-MM-DD.

department_ids.description: One or more comma separated department IDs. Filters report contents to include information for specified departments if so configured in the company file.

accounting_method.description: The accounting method used in the report.

summarize_column_by.description: The criteria by which to group the report results.

FREEAGENT_GET_THE_OPENING_BALANCES.description: Tool to retrieve the opening balances from the trial balance summary. Use when you need to get the initial balance amounts for all account categories at the start of the accounting period.

QUICKBOOKS_GET_GENERAL_LEDGER_REPORT.description: Generate a General Ledger report showing all transactions with debits, credits, and running balances. Use when you need a detailed view of all accounting transactions posted to each account.

columns.description: Column types to show in the report. Comma-separated list of column names (e.g., 'tx_date,txn_type,doc_num,name,memo,account,debit,credit,balance').

sort_by.description: The column type on which to base sorting (e.g., 'tx_date', 'account', 'txn_type'). Default is 'txn_type' if not specified.

end_date.description: End date for the report period in YYYY-MM-DD format.

class_ids.description: List of class IDs to filter the report. If not provided, the report includes all classes. Each ID should be the Class.Id value (e.g., ['1', '2']).

date_macro.description: Predefined date range. Use if you want the report to cover a standard report date range; otherwise, use start_date and end_date to cover an explicit report date range.

sort_order.description: The sort order for rows (ascending or descending). Default is ascending.

start_date.description: Start date for the report period in YYYY-MM-DD format.

vendor_ids.description: List of vendor IDs to filter the report. If not provided, the report includes all vendors. Each ID should be the Vendor.Id value (e.g., ['1', '3']).

account_ids.description: List of account IDs to filter the report. If not provided, the report includes all accounts. Each ID should be the Account.Id value from the Account object (e.g., ['1', '35', '82']).

account_type.description: Account type from which to include transactions (e.g., 'Bank', 'Expense', 'Income').

customer_ids.description: List of customer IDs to filter the report. If not provided, the report includes all customers. Each ID should be the Customer.Id value (e.g., ['1', '5']).

department_ids.description: List of department IDs to filter the report. If not provided, the report includes all departments. Filters report contents to include information for specified departments if so configured in the company file.

accounting_method.description: The accounting method used in the report (Cash or Accrual).

source_account_ids.description: List of source account IDs to filter the report. Each ID should be the Account.Id value for the source account.

source_account_type.description: Source account type for transaction filtering.
